title: Fixed Oval Pin Pad and Continuous Paddle Grip Brush
description: One newly authored complete static oval paddle-brush exterior. A single finite continuous body joins the broad oval head to a narrowed neck and long rounded-ended grip. One complete shallow raised oval pad sits within the head perimeter, carrying a field of complete short blunt pins with widened rounded-profile tips. Every pin is individually closed and embedded at its entire root in the pad; the complete pin field is grouped as one mesh, not counted as separate models. All numeric geometry newly authored, no imported tuft bundle, old brush body, comb head or detached part. Unlike the long rectangular bee-brush back with tall swept tuft bundles, this is a broad oval padded pin head on a long narrow paddle grip, with no blind-socket or hanging-hole claim. Three constant opaque PBR roles, metres Z up and whole horizontally centred ground datum under the full body. One original model zero scenes. Static illustrative exterior only: no hair, person, scalp contact, grooming, flex, brushing performance, comfort, pin safety, material suitability, hygiene, manufacture or safety capability. No rigging animation or interaction.
